_about: Neon Book (Iman Gadzhi shorts look), v4 7 Oct 2026. Ref rank 84 (s7361744177543122182, maxmill_ae 'Day 1 Editing like Iman Gadzhi'): a dark studio speaker under neon blue/red light, bold white caps with ONE glowing blue word, the explainer moments told with glowing 3D objects on a black stage (a book that splits into a page stack, '15 pages of gold' vs '300 pages of fluff', a price tag), and a white four-point star burst that floods the frame into a blue brand card. The ref is a side-by-side showcase (Iman's edit above, the recreation below); only the edit inside the frames is copied, never the split or the labels.

director.style: Neon Book: the Iman Gadzhi shorts look. A dark, neon-lit talking head (blue and red light), bold white caps captions with ONE glowing blue word per line, and the explainer moments shown as glowing objects on a black stage. Confident, premium, fast but clean.
director.captions: captions.heroes: the number or the money word of each line (never filler). Caps, centred, under the chin.
director.objects: 2-3 popcard beats per 30 s: an object PNG with a transparent background (assets/*.png: laptop, hourglass, calendar, book, phone) in object mode (no frame, tinted blue, glowing) on the dimmed, defocused camera, with a short white label (a price, a number, 2-4 words: '$11.99', '2 HOURS / WEEK'). 1.2-2.0 s each, on the noun as it is spoken. Objects only (tools, things, symbols); never an illustration of people.
director.numbers: Spoken numbers become stats badges (bg accent, 1-2 badges, a short label) or a big count-up: '500 employees', '1,000 hours'. One per 15 s at most.
director.transitions: ONE starflash per reel at the turn (problem -> answer), 0.6-0.8 s, no field. End on a starflash with field ['#0B1C8F', '#1E7BFF'] and the brand or CTA as text (1.4-2 s), when the reel has an outro.
director.rhythm: cadence.targetPerMin fills the gaps between scenes with punch-ins; keep scenes evenly spread, no more than one every 3 s.
director.dont: No side-by-side split, no 'IMAN GADZHI' or editor labels, no other creator's name or logo. No red text.
